description: Performance sweep - Java: valkey-glide vs lettuce (high-throughput configs). There is no bench-aws.sh version flag for this client: bump valkey-glide.version in java/pom.xml on a pushed ref and pass --repo-tag. lettuce is the stable yardstick, so compare GLIDE/lettuce ratios across runs to cancel instance-to-instance noise. Connections and iterations match perf-ruby.
